greeting.text: Let a Yeti witness contest the accepted table without abandoning rigor. Our capital is Migbushoprahshotra. Its principal will register this work after the local balance. The outlying witness is at Migwamaw (500, 500).

choices.text: Let a Yeti witness contest the accepted table without abandoning rigor.

actions.value: Keep the wisdom obligation; publish revisions honestly.

hint:mission:antipion:wisdom.text: Let a Yeti witness contest the accepted table without abandoning rigor. Inspect Migwamaw at 500, 500, listen to the visiting witness, and repair the circuit beside Antipions Mediator. Inspect the independent reading at Migwamaw. Listen to the Yetis witness. Record a testable commitment with the circuit keeper. Restore the regional circuit.
